title: GMAT Focus Quant Practice Test 4
instructions: GMAT Focus Edition Quantitative Reasoning: 21 Problem Solving questions, 45 minutes. An on-screen calculator is permitted.

questions.prompt: Three partners invested £12,000.00, £18,000.00, £30,000.00. A profit of £21,600.00 is divided in proportion to capital. What does the largest investor receive?
questions.explanation: Total capital is £60,000.00, so the largest investor's share is £30,000.00/£60,000.00 = half: £10,800.00. Dividing equally would give £7,200.00.

questions.prompt: A sequence starts at 8 and increases by 6 each term. What is the sum of the first 25 terms?
questions.explanation: The 25th term is 8 + 24 × 6 = 152. The sum is 25 × (8 + 152) / 2 = 2,000. Quoting the final term instead of the sum is the usual error.

questions.prompt: A van worth £18,000.00 loses 25% of its value each year. After how many whole years is it worth less than £6,000.00?
questions.explanation: Values fall to £13,500.00, £10,125.00, £7,593.75, £5,695.31. It first drops below £6,000.00 after 4 years.

questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a perpendicular height of 9 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area is half the base times the height: 14 × 9 / 2 = 63 square centimetres. Forgetting to halve gives 126.

questions.prompt: The radius of a circle is increased by 30%. By what percentage does its area increase?
questions.explanation: Area scales with the square of the radius: 1.3² = 1.69, an increase of 69%. The radius rise of 30% is the trap.

questions.prompt: A tap fills a tank in 5 hours. A leak alone would empty a full tank in 20 hours. With both running from empty, how long does the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate is 1/5 − 1/20 = 3/20 of the tank an hour, so filling takes 20/3 = 6.7 hours. Subtracting the times to get 15 hours is wrong; rates subtract, not times.

questions.prompt: An item costs £44.00. At what price must it sell for the profit to be 35% of the selling price?
questions.explanation: If profit is 35% of the price, cost is 65% of it, so the price is £44.00 / 0.65 = £67.69. Adding 35% to cost gives £59.40, which is a 35% markup on cost, not a 35% margin.

questions.prompt: A course mark combines coursework (30%, scored 72), an examination (50%, scored 64) and a project (20%, scored 81). What is the overall mark?
questions.explanation: Weighted: 0.30×72 + 0.50×64 + 0.20×81 = 69.8. The unweighted average of the three scores is 72.3, which over-weights the components worth least.

questions.prompt: One unit of currency B buys 1.18 units of currency A, and one unit of currency C buys 9.4 units of currency B. How many units of A does one unit of C buy?
questions.explanation: Multiply the rates: 1.18 × 9.4 = 11.09 units of A per unit of C. Dividing instead gives 7.97.

questions.prompt: What is the units digit of 7 raised to the power 23?
questions.explanation: Units digits of powers of 7 cycle 7, 9, 3, 1 with period 4. Since 23 = 4 × 5 + 3, the answer matches the third in the cycle: 3.

questions.prompt: A boat travels at 12 km/h in still water. It goes 45 km downstream and returns, on a river flowing at 3 km/h. How long does the round trip take?
questions.explanation: Downstream speed 15 km/h takes 3.0 hours; upstream at 9 km/h takes 5.0 hours. Total 8.0 hours — longer than the 7.5 hours the still-water speed alone would suggest.

questions.prompt: Income of £46,000.00 is taxed at 20% on the amount above a tax-free allowance of £12,570.00. What is the tax due?
questions.explanation: Taxable income is £46,000.00 − £12,570.00 = £33,430.00, and 20% of that is £6,686.00. Taxing the whole income gives £9,200.00.

questions.prompt: Seven values are 12, 15, 15, 15, 19, 22, 40. What is the difference between the mean and the median?
questions.explanation: The mean is 138/7 = 19.71 and the median is the fourth value, 15. The difference is 4.7, driven by the single value of 40.

questions.prompt: A team of 4 is chosen from 10 people, and two named individuals must both be included. In how many ways can the team be formed?
questions.explanation: The two named members take two places, so the remaining 2 places come from the other 8: 8 × 7 / 2 = 28. Choosing freely from all ten gives 210.

questions.prompt: Equipment costing £2,400.00 saves £145.00 a month. After how many whole months has it paid for itself?
questions.explanation: £2,400.00 / £145.00 = 16.6 months, so it first covers its cost in month 17.

questions.prompt: A car travels 42 miles on a gallon of fuel costing £6.55. What is the fuel cost per mile, to the nearest penny?
questions.explanation: Cost per mile is the price of a gallon divided by the miles it covers: £6.55 / 42 = 0.156, which rounds to £0.16. Dividing the other way round gives a figure in miles per pound, not pounds per mile.

questions.prompt: Two similar rectangles have corresponding sides in the ratio 3 : 2. What is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation: Areas of similar figures scale with the square of the side ratio: (3/2)² = 2.25, so the areas are in the ratio 9 : 4. The cube, 27 : 8, applies to volumes.

questions.prompt: £5,000.00 earns 4.8% a year, compounded monthly. How much interest is earned in one year, to the nearest penny?
questions.explanation: Monthly compounding gives £5,000.00 × (1 + 0.048/12)¹² − £5,000.00 = £245.35, slightly more than the £240.00 that annual simple interest would pay.

questions.prompt: A retailer holds average stock of £84,000.00 and has annual cost of goods sold of £511,000.00. How many days of stock does it hold, to the nearest day?
questions.explanation: Stock days are average stock divided by annual cost of sales, times 365: £84,000.00 / £511,000.00 × 365 = 60.0, or 60 days.

questions.prompt: Production costs £9,000.00 in fixed costs plus £6.50 a unit. By how much does the cost per unit fall when output rises from 1,000 to 3,000 units?
questions.explanation: At 1,000 units the cost per unit is £15.50; at 3,000 it is £9.50. The fall is £6.00, entirely from spreading the fixed cost.

questions.prompt: A tax rate rises from 12% to 15%. By what percentage has the rate itself increased?
questions.explanation: The rise is 3 percentage points, but as a proportion of the original rate it is 3/12 = 25%. Reporting 3% confuses a percentage point with a percentage.
